statement: A long tube with wavy markings and a round blue cap at its top-right end runs down between the two top text columns and coils into a long blue basin with a looped border, holding two bursts of radiating lines. Ten pipes hang from the basin, each touching the head of one of ten nude women standing half-length in a long green tub; nine pipes widen into a jar-like section holding a two-line label, the tenth (rightmost) is a thin tube with its label beside it. A thin blue tube runs from the green tub down the left margin into a lower blue pool of two joined basins with hatched rims, holding about 19 nude women; a blue tube leaves its bottom and runs to the page edge. The ten two-line label pairs (f75v.18-37) are given to the ten women left to right, each by its first line (18, 20, ..., 36), assuming the transcription lists them in left-to-right order; this was not checked against the words. The labels f75v.50-56 float around the lower pool without a clear single target and are not attached. The label lines f75v.2-11 are single marks at the right ends of the top text lines, not labels of drawings.
